projectDescription: A Kubernetes operator that automatically generates and manages NetworkPolicies from observed traffic patterns, supporting learning/enforcing modes and multiple CNI backends (Kubernetes, Cilium, Calico).
keyFeatures: Learning mode: observes live cluster traffic to discover namespace and rule suggestions before enforcing
Enforcing mode: automatically applies generated NetworkPolicies based on learned patterns or predefined rules
Multi-CNI support: generates native policies for Kubernetes NetworkPolicy, Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy, and Calico NetworkPolicy
Pod label selector: target specific pods within a namespace rather than the entire namespace
CIDR-based rules: define ingress/egress rules for external IP ranges with optional exception ranges
Named port support: reference ports by service name (http, grpc, https) rather than numeric port numbers
Dry run mode: preview generated policies in status without applying them to the cluster
Policy diff/audit: track policy Created/Updated changes in status for audit trails
Built-in policy templates: zero-trust, web-app, backend-api, database, monitoring
Prometheus metrics: reconcile count, duration, active generators, policy operations
Schema validation via CEL rules in the CRD itself — no extra admission controller required
Optional admission webhook for additional CIDR and cross-field validation
publicApiSurface: CRD: NetworkPolicyGenerator (security.policy.io/v1)
spec.mode: learning | enforcing
spec.duration: learning duration (required when mode=learning)
spec.policyEngine: kubernetes | cilium | calico
spec.templateName: zero-trust | web-app | backend-api | database | monitoring
spec.dryRun: bool — preview policies without applying
spec.policy.type: allow | deny
spec.policy.allowedNamespaces: list of allowed source namespaces
spec.policy.deniedNamespaces: list of denied source namespaces
spec.policy.podSelector: label map to restrict target pods
spec.globalRules[]: port/namedPort rules with protocol and direction
spec.cidrRules[]: CIDR-based rules with optional except[] ranges
status.phase: current lifecycle phase
status.lastAnalyzed: timestamp of last traffic analysis
status.observedTraffic: collected traffic flows from learning mode
status.suggestedNamespaces: namespace suggestions from learning mode
status.suggestedRules: traffic-derived rule suggestions
status.generatedPolicies: serialized policy JSON (used in dry-run mode)
status.policyDiff: Created/Updated audit entries
status.appliedPoliciesCount: number of currently active policies
Operator flag: --enable-webhooks (enables admission webhook, requires cert-manager)
Operator flag: --leader-elect (enables leader election)
Operator flag: --metrics-bind-address (default :8443)
Operator flag: --health-probe-bind-address (default :8081)
Prometheus metrics: npg_reconcile_total, npg_policies_applied, npg_policy_operations_total, npg_generators_active, npg_reconcile_duration_seconds, npg_dry_run_total, npg_validation_errors_total
Helm chart: oci://ghcr.io/somaz94/charts/network-policy-generator
Container image: somaz940/network-policy-generator:v0.4.0
